issues.main_description_html:
GoThru SSO Test Cases

Here is a comprehensive list of test cases for the GoThru SSO flows. Note: Registration is placed first so testers can generate valid credentials to use for the subsequent Login and Forgot Password tests.
Link Access https://app.gothru.co/auth?auth=keycloak

1. Registration (Sign Up)

  • Verify successful registration with valid details (First Name, Last Name, Email, Password, Confirm Password).
  • Verify registration failure when the email address is already in use.
  • Verify validation errors are shown for invalid email formats (e.g., missing @, missing domain).
  • Verify password complexity requirements are enforced (minimum length, special characters, uppercase, lowercase, numbers).
  • Verify error message when "Password" and "Confirm Password" do not match.
  • Verify the user receives a verification email upon successful registration.
  • Edge Case: Attempt registration with extremely long inputs in the Name and Email fields.
  • Edge Case: Attempt SQL injection or Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) payloads in the registration fields.

2. Login

  • Verify successful login with valid credentials (email and password) created during the Registration phase.
  • Verify successful login with valid credentials (username and password).
  • Verify login failure with an unregistered email/username.
  • Verify login failure with a valid email/username but incorrect password.
  • Verify error message is displayed when attempting to log in with empty fields.
  • Verify the "Remember Me" functionality retains the user session after browser restart.
  • Edge Case: Verify login behavior with leading/trailing spaces in the email/username field.
  • Edge Case: Verify behavior when multiple users try to log in simultaneously (Concurrency).

3. Forgot Password / Reset Password

  • Verify the "Forgot Password" link on the login page redirects to the correct form.
  • Verify submitting a valid, registered email address sends a password reset link.
  • Verify submitting an unregistered email address displays a generic message to prevent user enumeration (e.g., "If your email is registered, you will receive a reset link").
  • Verify the password reset link in the email redirects to the login-update-password page.
  • Verify the password reset link expires after the configured time limit.
  • Verify the password reset link becomes invalid immediately after it has been used once.
  • Verify successful password update with a valid new password.
  • Verify the user can log in with the new password and cannot log in with the old password.
  • Edge Case: Verify that the new password cannot be the same as the old password (if password history is enforced).

4. Social Login (Google) & Account Linking

  • Verify clicking "Log in with Google" redirects the user to the Google authentication page.
  • Verify successful login/registration when the user authenticates with a valid Google account.
  • Verify the user's details (Email, First Name, Last Name) are properly mapped and saved in the SSO system from the Google profile.
  • Verify canceling the Google authentication process redirects the user back to the login page gracefully.
  • Account Linking: Register an account using email/password, then attempt to log in using Google with the same email. Verify the accounts are linked properly or the user is prompted to link them.
  • Account Linking: Log in with Google first, then attempt to register an account manually using the same email address.

5. Required Actions (Keycloak Specific)

  • Verify Email: Verify that a user cannot access the application until they click the verification link sent to their email (if "Verify Email" is a required action).
  • Update Profile: Verify the login-update-profile.ftl page appears on first login if the user is missing required profile information, and verify the user cannot proceed without filling it out.
  • Update Password: Verify that an admin can force a user to reset their password on their next login, and the login-update-password.ftl screen prevents them from proceeding until changed.

6. Security, Rate Limiting & Session Management

  • Brute Force Protection: Verify that consecutive failed login attempts result in a temporary account lockout or trigger a CAPTCHA.
  • Verify successful logout and that the user cannot access protected resources or use the browser's "Back" button to return to an authenticated session.
  • Verify session expiration after a period of inactivity (idle timeout).
  • Verify session expiration after an absolute maximum time limit (lifespan timeout).
  • Verify CSRF (Cross-Site Request Forgery) tokens are present and validated on all forms (login, register, reset password).
  • Verify that password fields are masked (using type="password").

7. UI / UX and Accessibility

  • Verify all SSO pages (Login, Register, Forgot Password) are fully responsive on mobile, tablet, and desktop viewports.
  • Verify keyboard navigation (Tab key) works sequentially through all input fields and buttons.
  • Verify that form validation errors are clearly visible and color-coded (e.g., red text/borders).
  • Verify that localization works properly (if multiple languages are supported).
  • Verify the design matches the exact brand guidelines for GoThru (colors, fonts, logos, spacing) based on styles.css.

QA Tester Summary - Issue #4302: Test Cases: GoThru SSO Comprehensive Flows

Suite: qa_testing/e2e/authentication/issue_4302_keycloak_sso.spec.js (Playwright - Chromium)
Env: Production https://app.gothru.co - Keycloak SSO Realm (https://id.gothru.org)

Test Scenario & Result

# Box Scenario Given -> Expected Matrix Result
1 White SSO Entry & Auto Redirection Access /auth?auth=keycloak -> Auto-redirect to Hosted Keycloak SSO (id.gothru.org) with PKCE parameters TP Pass
2 White SSO Registration UI Navigation Click "Create an account" -> Render Registration Form (First Name, Last Name, Email, Terms Agreement) TP Pass
3 White SSO Form Input & Masking Access Login/Register SSO -> Password fields masked (type="password") & interactive form controls TP Pass
4 Gray Callback Flow Protection Access /auth/keycloak/callback without valid auth code -> Safe error handling / redirect protection TP Pass
5 Task Sprint #4302 SSO Flow Acceptance Comprehensive verification of registration and sign-in flows on Keycloak SSO TP Pass
